items.label: Provide Sandbags to Greatly Improve Stability
items.value: The ABS stable base is 9 inches in diameter, wider than most of base in the market. Its larger round base provides more stability and durability, helping to hold the boat cover in harsh weather. The sandbags are also provided so that the pole performs unprecedented stability efficiency!

items.label: Durable & Rustproof Steel Pole
items.value: The steel pole is 1-1/8-inch in diameter, has a wall thickness of 1mm, can withstand pressures of more than 200 pounds, and is much stronger and more durable than other plastic poles; The powder design Steel Pole to prevent rust, passed salt spray test.

items.label: ADJUSTABLE STRAPS
items.value: The heavy duty 5" large mushroom cap features with 3 holes (1.4inch long and 0.4inch wide ) for threading straps through and hold the boat pole upright while putting the cover on, or during high winter winds. The mushroom cap is made of high quality ABS material than others on the market to prevent tearing your cover, prolong the service life

items.label: Easy to achive 4 Adjustable Heights
items.value: The steel poles can be easily removed with the push-button locking system, to achieve the height of 17inch, 30inch, 42inch and 55inch respectively, which can better match the depth of the boat or the height you need to support the boat cover OR furniture cover.
